Messages.Author: Ashenbach
Messages.Body:
Hi all

¿Can a vampire have multiple Clotho's Gift cards? In the card nothing
saids about it and i suppose that the answer is "yes".

If a vampire can have 2 or more Clotho's Gift, ¿can he untap any
number of times equal to the number of Clotho's Gift he has?

¿What happen when Nu gets a Clotho's Gift? ¿Can he untap once more, or
the Clotho's Gift replace the innate ability of the Pillar? I suppose
that he can do untap twice.

Thanks for Replaying

HAPPY BLEEDING!!!

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>¿Can a vampire have multiple Clotho's Gift cards? In the card nothing
>saids about it and i suppose that the answer is "yes".

Yes. All cards stack by default.

>If a vampire can have 2 or more Clotho's Gift, ¿can he untap any
>number of times equal to the number of Clotho's Gift he has?

Yes.

>¿What happen when Nu gets a Clotho's Gift? ¿Can he untap once more, or
>the Clotho's Gift replace the innate ability of the Pillar? I suppose
>that he can do untap twice.

Yes. Notice however that all of this is rather blood-intensive.

Halcyan 2
